Identical backend-audit instrumentation in retained binaries, not production source. Its logging overhead is not subtracted.
CPU profile fractions are post-window stack attribution, not directly measured per-component cores.
Heaps sampled before CPU capture in main and native_repeat. Native first-run heaps are excluded because CPU capture pauses allocation sampling.

Main post-window inventory failed on a native-only relation. Exact SQL failure reproduced and common raw-relation inventory passed on restart. Original idle/counter/CPU/heap measurements passed and are unchanged.
Current scan counters are measured. Older scan-origin evidence identifies mechanisms but is not a fresh per-caller rate split.
Caches overlap heap allocations. jemalloc_retained is virtual retention, not resident memory. PSS includes more than sampled heap.
No production optimization or changed cadence. No CI claim.
